title: Indices matching a fixed assignment
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $P$ be a finite subset of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $z$ assign a sign to each index in $P$. For a natural number $R$ and a family $(f_i)_{i=0}^{R-1}$ of such assignments, the matching index set is $\{i\in\{0,\ldots,R-1\}: f_i=z\}$.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a finite subset of the indices $0,\ldots,n-1$
$z$ assigns a sign to each index in $P$
$f_i$ is an assignment on $P$ for each index $i<R$
